verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a SaaS project-management product, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its pricing page explicitly claims "Official Basecamp support for ChatGPT, Claude, and AI agents with full MCP support," which is direct first-party support for connecting agents via MCP. The evidence is a single marketing line; the GitHub material points agents to Skills and a CLI rather than documenting an MCP server. Missing for 10: MCP server setup and connection docs, endpoint or transport details, tool coverage list, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Official Basecamp support for ChatGPT, Claude, and AI agents with full MCP support.
